articles.title: Crack a Case: The Science of Blood Spatter from Your Kitchen
articles.summary: Forensic scientists use blood spatter to reconstruct crimes. With fake blood and a ruler, you can test how drop size changes with height. Ready to gather evidence?

articles.title: Dark Matter's Hidden Force: A Cosmic Brake, Not a Gas Pedal
articles.summary: A new study reveals that an attractive 'dark force' in dark matter actually suppresses the growth of cosmic structures, contradicting intuitive expectations. The finding could reshape cosmological models.

articles.title: Bemotrizinol: The New Sunscreen Ingredient That's Been 25 Years in the Making
articles.summary: The FDA has approved bemotrizinol, a photostable UVA blocker used abroad for decades. It's the first new sunscreen ingredient in the U.S. in 20 years, hitting shelves this summer.
